 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Uday Kumar, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sri S. Ehteshamuddin, APP

== ================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. Issue notice upon the Opposite Party No. 2 by both modes i.e. registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary post for which requisites etc., must be filed on or before 21.12.2023 failing which this application shall stand rejected without further reference to a Bench.
3. Put up this case on 12.02.2024.

4. In the meantime, the order dated 06.09.2017 passed by the learned SDJM, Pupri, Sitamarhi in Complaint Case No. C1/85/2017 whereby cognizance of offence under Section 498A Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.58128 of 2017(2) dt.12-12-2023 of the Indian Penal Code has been taken, shall remain stayed.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners are sister-in-law (Nanad),
brother-in-law (Devar) and father-in-law of the O.P. No. 02.

It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife the entire family members are implicated, in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations, in order to coerce the husband into submission.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioners at this stage seeks permission to make rectification in the pleadings at Para-9 of the quashing application.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Adnan/-
